description: This source file defines a class 'Passwords' which is a snippet for demonstrating password security features in PDF documents using the PDFsharp library. It includes methods to create PDF documents with owner and user passwords and to add hyperlinks to the PDFs. The class inherits from SnippetBase and overrides a rendering method to display sample boxes.

classes.name: Passwords
classes.description: A snippet class demonstrating password-protected PDF creation and hyperlink addition using PDFsharp.
